description: Daily AI-agent work-share quota. Codex is fallback-only and must stay at or below its configured share of each day's master-coordinator dispatched AI work; Claude/OpenCode/free cloud agents are preferred by default.
recording: Every master-coordinator dispatched subtask records one work unit for its agent (deduplicated by agent+taskId+day).
enforcement: master-coordinator refuses Codex dispatch once today's recorded Codex share reaches maxCodexDailySharePercent.
unconfiguredDefault: fail closed: if the quota ledger is unreadable, Codex dispatch is refused until the ledger is inspectable.
